objective: Execute SAKG-2 Task 24 [I-KAE-CAS-CITATIONS] from the ratified SAEOS-1 architecture (spec/SAEOS-1-architecture.md §5.2, RB-0004). Implement kae/citation_pipeline.py to extract byte-anchored citations from external documents/RFCs stored in immutable CAS, minting schema-compliant EvidenceRef nodes in the live SAKG SQLite GraphStore (sakg.db). Connect these EvidenceRef nodes to Decisions and Constraints via "justified_by" or "evidence" edges. Author tests in tests/kae/test_citation_pipeline.py verifying byte-exact CAS anchoring, idempotent ingestion, deterministic evidence hashing, and fail-closed rejection of corrupted or missing CAS references.
accept: No runtime, kernel, protected ref, main/trunk, or historical evidence mutation
